items.source: Implementations will typically create ResourcePropertySource instances, with PropertySourceProcessor automatically adapting property source names via ResourcePropertySource.withResourceName() if necessary, for example, when combining multiple sources for the same name into a CompositePropertySource. Custom implementations with custom PropertySource types need to make sure to expose distinct enough names, possibly deriving from ResourcePropertySource where possible.
items.translation: 实现通常会创建 `ResourcePropertySource` 实例，并在必要时通过 `ResourcePropertySource.withResourceName()` 自动调整属性源名称（例如，当将多个同名源合并为 `CompositePropertySource` 时），由 `PropertySourceProcessor` 处理。具有自定义 `PropertySource` 类型的自定义实现需要确保暴露足够独特的名称，在可能的情况下从 `ResourcePropertySource` 派生。

items.source: Strategy interface for creating resource-based PropertySource wrappers.
items.translation: 用于创建基于资源的PropertySource包装器的策略接口。

items.source: Create a PropertySource that wraps the given resource.
items.translation: 创建一个PropertySource以包装给定的资源。
新的PropertySource(永远不为null)

items.source: name - the name of the property source (can be null in which case the factory implementation will have to generate a name based on the given resource)
items.translation: `name` - 属性源名称（可为 `null`，此时工厂实现必须根据给定资源生成名称）

items.source: IOException - if resource resolution failed
items.translation: IOException - 如果资源解析失败
resource - 要包装的资源（可能已编码）
